# Served on pict.live only -- middleware.js rewrites /robots.txt to this file
# when the request host is pict.live. The generated public/robots.txt is the
# theinterviewroom.in version and is regenerated by next-sitemap every build,
# so this file must stay hand-written and separate.
User-agent: *
Allow: /placements
Disallow: /login
Disallow: /profile
Disallow: /post
Disallow: /add-company
Disallow: /edit
Disallow: /edit-company
Disallow: /search

Sitemap: https://pict.live/sitemap-pict.xml
